sql.sql: select "state", count(*) from "jobs" where ("jobs"."workspace_id" = ? and not exists(select 1 from settings where workspace_id = "jobs"."workspace_id" and key = 'jobHidden.' || "jobs"."id" and value = 'true')) group by "jobs"."state"

select "id", "workspace_id", "type", "payload_json", "label", "state", "run_at", "attempts", "max_attempts", "lease_until", "lease_version", "priority", "idempotency_key", "last_error", "result_json", "created_at", "updated_at" from "jobs" where ("jobs"."workspace_id" = ? and not exists(select 1 from settings where workspace_id = "jobs"."workspace_id" and key = 'jobHidden.' || "jobs"."id" and value = 'true')) order by "jobs"."created_at" desc, "jobs"."id" desc limit ?
